BALOCHISTAN CIVIL SERVANTS (SENIORITY) RULES, 2008
BALOCHISTAN CIVIL SERVANTS (SENIORITY) RULES, 2008
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 16th January, 2013]
No.S.O(R-I)1(17)/2013-S&GAD/279-378,
dated 16-1-2013.---In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 25 of the
Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974 (Act No. IX of 1974), the Government of
Balochistan is pleased to make the following amendments to the Balochistan
Civil Servants (Seniority) Rules, 2018, namely:
In the aforesaid rules,--
(a) in rule
2, for sub-rule (1) the following shall be substituted;--
"(1) In
these rules, unless there is anything repugnant to the subject or context,--
(a) "Appointing
Authority" in relation to a post, means the Authority Competent under
rule 4 of the Balochistan Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer)
Rules, 2009 to make appointment to that post;
(b) "Chief
Secretary" means an officer as defined in the Balochistan Government
Rules of Business;
(c) "Commission"
means Balochistan Public Service Commission;
(d) "Departmental
Promotion Committee" means a Committee constituted under rule 5 of the
Balochistan Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Rules, 2009
for making selection for promotion to such posts under a Department or office
of Government in Basic Pay Scales 16 and below or equivalent;
(e) "Departmental
Selection Committee" means a Committee constituted under rule 5 of the
Balochistan Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Rules, 2009
for the purpose of making selection for initial appointment to post under a
Department or office of Government in basic Pay Scales 15 and below or
equivalent;
(f) "Final
Seniority List" means the Seniority List issued under rule 2-A,
sub-rule 4;
(g) "Head
of Department" means an Administrative Secretary to Government of
Balochistan;
(h) "Heads
of Attached Departments" an officer as defined in the Balochistan
Government Rules of Business;
(i) "Government"
means the Government of Balochistan;
(j) "Provincial
Selection Board" means a Board constituted by Government under rule
6-A of the Balochistan Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer)
Rules, 2009 for the purpose of selection, promotion or transfer;
(k) "Provisional
Seniority List" means a Seniority List issued under rule 2-A, sub-rule
(3);
(l) "Schedule"
means Schedule attached to these rules;
(m) "Selection
Authority" means the Balochistan Public Service Commission or the
Departmental Selection/Recruitment Committee as the case may be; and
(n) "Seniority"
means the seniority assigned to a civil servant in a seniority list caused by
the appointing authority to be prepared in accordance to the provisions of
section 8 of the Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974 and these rules.
(b) after
rule 2, the following new rule shall be inserted,
namely:--
"2-A.
Issuance of Seniority List: (1) As provided in section 8 of the Balochistan
Civil Servants Act, 1974, the appointing authority shall every year in the
month of January cause a seniority list of the members for the time being of
such service, cadre or post to be prepared, or revised the seniority list
prepared in the previous year, as the case may be, in the manner as provided
hereunder.
(2) The
appointing authority or where the appointing authority is the Provincial
Government or the Chief Secretary, the Head of Department concerned and in case
of Civil Servants (BPS- 1 to BPS 15) of Attached Departments, the Heads of
Attached Departments, shall in the first instance prepare a Provisional
Seniority List in the month of October every year in the Forms mentioned in
Schedule appended to these rules, and satisfied itself that--
(a) all due
care has been taken in the preparation of the list;
(b) no
member has been left from mentioning in the list;
(c) all the
particulars mentioned in the list about the members are entered correctly in
accordance to the record of the department;
(d) the
appointment of the member was made on regular
